home.heroDescription: Meet local builders, learn practical workflows, and make ambitious software with people nearby.
home.closingDescription: Join the next {communityName} event in {city}, or download Cursor and start building today.

footer.madeWith: Made with Cursor by ambassadors worldwide

featured.defaultDescription: Slides, guides, and materials shared by your local Cursor community.

photos.title: A note on photos
photos.description: We'll be taking photos and videos during the event for social media and future Cursor Community content.
photos.preference: If you'd prefer not to be photographed:
photos.option1: Let the host know when you arrive
photos.option2: We'll make sure to respect your preference

matchmaking.title: Want to meet new people?
matchmaking.step1: Come to the host table and grab a {numberCard} (1-10)
matchmaking.question2: "Are you building something cool with Cursor?"

worldEvents.title: Cafe Cursor around the world
worldEvents.description: Cursor users are building together worldwide. Even with timezone differences, we are one community.

credits.heading: Claim your Cursor credits
credits.description: If you registered on Luma and came to the kickoff, enter the email you used to RSVP. You get the same code or link if you come back.
credits.successBody: Save this code or link. You can open this page again with the same email if you need it.
credits.successReused: This email already claimed. Here is the same credit as before.
credits.notFoundHeading: We could not match that email
credits.notFoundBody: Please see the organizers at the end of the event and we will help you there.
credits.exhaustedHeading: No credits left in the pool
credits.exhaustedBody: Please see the organizers at the end of the event.
credits.rateLimited: Too many attempts from this network. Wait a few minutes and try again.
credits.unavailable: Credits are not open yet. Please see the organizers.
credits.needQrBody: Credits are only handed out from the printed QR at the venue. See the organizers if you do not have it.
credits.adminDescription: Upload the Luma guest CSV and the credit pool. This view is password-protected and not indexed.
credits.adminLoadError: Could not load the organizer view.
credits.adminSaveError: Could not save. Check the CSV and try again.
credits.adminLoadHelp: Use the Luma guest export (CSV). Only approved or registered guests can claim. Codes stay on the server.
credits.adminPoolFile: Unique codes or links (one per line)
credits.modeShared: Shared link (same for every registered email)
